title: Milestone 1: final scheduled vc4 kernel to candidate bundle
locked_goal: Given a vc4.module with exactly one kernel vc4.func where domain=qpu, form=scheduled, vc4.launch_abi exists, and the body contains only vc4.qpu.bundle/ldi/sema/branch, emit a candidate bundle that builds and runs for minimal_thrend-like and simple memory-output-like tests.

gate_environment_contract.lit_run_line_contract: Every %token in changed RUN lines must be defined by lit config or be a lit builtin. The gate runner also prepends compiler/build/bin to PATH for bare repo-built tools.

slices.title: Preflight repo and toolchain checks
slices.intent: Verify that the repo, build directory, existing VC4 tests, GPT web transport path, and minimal_thrend fixture are present before any GPT-generated compiler patch is requested.
non_goals: Do not contact GPT Pro.
Do not run Codex.
Do not modify compiler sources.
Do not run hardware.
slices.commit_message: vc4 codegen m1: preflight repo and toolchain checks

products.source_product_note: Preflight has no generated source product; it verifies existing repo/toolchain inputs by exact path.

slices.title: Add vc4-codegen artifact tool skeleton
slices.intent: Add a standalone vc4-codegen executable backed by reusable Target/VC4 library stubs. It must parse MLIR, find exactly one eligible kernel, reject invalid inputs cleanly, and write placeholder kernel.qasm, kernel_launch.c, kernel_launch.h, and manifest.json files into --emit-bundle.
non_goals: Do not implement real qasm emission beyond placeholders.
Do not implement launcher ABI packing.
Do not implement hardware runner integration.
Do not change existing dialect semantics.
slices.commit_message: vc4 codegen m1: add vc4-codegen artifact tool skeleton

products.source_product_note: The skeleton slice owns the vc4-codegen tool/library surface and its two local skeleton tests by exact filename.

slices.title: Lock Milestone 1 input-boundary tests
slices.intent: Add local non-hardware tests, and tighten vc4-codegen validation only as needed, for the exact Milestone 1 input boundary: exactly one vc4.module in the parsed MLIR module, exactly one kernel qpu scheduled vc4.func, vc4.launch_abi present, allowed scheduled sink ops only, and a flattened scheduled instruction stream whose final three slots are one explicit thrend followed by two non-branch delay-slot instructions. Local product tests must be named compiler/test/CodeGen/VC4/Emit/vc4-codegen-emit-contract-*.mlir so the deterministic product gate can prove the slice exists. Emitter-level negative tests must be dialect-verifier-clean; if the dialect verifier intentionally rejects the IR first, FileCheck must match that verifier diagnostic instead of an emitter diagnostic. Branch epilogue tests must keep each vc4.qpu.branch operation verifier-clean with exactly three delay-slot ops unless the test is explicitly about branch verifier precedence.
non_goals: Do not implement new qasm features.
Do not broaden the accepted input subset.
Do not silently repair invalid scheduled IR; reject boundary violations with clear diagnostics.
Do not change reference hardware bundles.
Do not expect emitter diagnostics for IR that the dialect verifier rejects first; use dialect-verifier-clean IR for emitter-boundary tests.
Do not add generated lit Output files or .lit_test_times.txt files.

Do not write CodeGen negative tests that are rejected by dialect verification before exercising this slice; keep emitter/codegen tests verifier-clean unless intentionally checking verifier precedence.
Do not include generated lit Output files or .lit_test_times.txt files.
Do not substitute semantically similar filenames for files declared in products.required_source_files or products.required_source_globs.
Do not substitute semantically similar filenames for files declared in products.required_source_files, products.required_source_globs, or products.candidate_input_files.
slices.commit_message: vc4 codegen m1: lock milestone 1 input-boundary tests

contract_cases: valid minimal_thrend-like scheduled kernel emits all placeholder bundle artifacts
reject multiple vc4.module or multiple eligible kernels
reject non-sink or structured operations in the scheduled kernel body
reject missing, early, repeated, or trailing thrend that is not exactly slot N-3
reject branch operations in slots N-2 or N-1 of the flattened stream
verifier_precedence_notes: vc4-codegen verifies MLIR before artifact emission.
Structured vc4.* operations in scheduled functions are rejected by the dialect verifier before emitter validation.
vc4.qpu.branch must have exactly three delay-slot ops before flattened epilogue validation can inspect it.
Emitter-level negative tests must be dialect-verifier-clean unless intentionally checking verifier precedence.
products.source_product_note: The emit-contract local product tests are the vc4-codegen-emit-contract-*.mlir files; boundary-* names do not satisfy the deterministic product gate.
